# Ignite Productions

> Veteran-owned (VOSB), full-service brand activation and field marketing agency. 257,000+ vetted brand ambassadors across all 50 states. Founded 2018 in Sparks, Nevada by Kyle Christiansen, a 20+ year CPG marketing veteran (Red Bull, 160over90, Amazon). Ignite runs experiential activations, product sampling, event staffing, mobile tours, trade shows, custom fabrication and fractional CPG leadership, and owns Spark, its proprietary in-house field marketing platform for GPS-verified check-ins, live photo capture and real-time activation reporting.

Ignite is the operator, not a marketplace: the same senior team scopes, staffs, runs and reports on each program. Ignite has 5,000+ events executed. Notable programs include multi-year national work for Liquid Death, plus White Claw, Mas+ by Messi, Total Wireless, Dude Wipes, Smalls Sliders and Krispy Krunchy. 200+ brands activated since 2018.

## Case studies
- [OpenAI Dev Day 2026](https://www.igniteproductions.co/portfolio/openai-devday): 87 brand ambassadors across product areas, keynote ushering, wayfinding, traffic and F&B.
- [Claude Code workshop tour](https://www.igniteproductions.co/portfolio/claude-code-workshops): 12-city tour with local teams.
- [Liquid Death](https://www.igniteproductions.co/portfolio/liquid-death): 1,000+ retail demos a year plus festival and event activations since 2018.
- [Torch THC](https://www.igniteproductions.co/portfolio/torch-thc): 2,500+ retail activations a year, national program.
- [Brew Dr. Kombucha](https://www.igniteproductions.co/portfolio/brew-dr): about 150 in-store demos a month.
- [Stone House Bread](https://www.igniteproductions.co/portfolio/stone-house-bread): 32 sampling events across 19 Kroger stores in 16 Michigan cities.
- [Breakaway Music Festival](https://www.igniteproductions.co/portfolio/breakaway): Jimmy John's silent disco and hiyo exit sampling across 12 festivals.
